name: load_background_music_wave_bank

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_LoadBackgroundMusicWaveBank passes the top value to func_0011E900 as the wave-bank ID, stores the preceding value minus one as the destination slot, and decrements Script stackTop by two

notes: func_0011E900 formats the ID as amusic/wave%4d.wd, and ScriptCommand_LoadBackgroundMusicWaveBank queues that file for asynchronous CD/DVD loading. Its completion chain passes the loaded buffer and zero-based slot into the sound loader before the paired background-music sequence is loaded by command 566. All five JP calls use slot 1 and are immediately followed by command 406's wave-bank load wait.
